# netbox_tokens (Data Source)

Lists token objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_tokens" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: created, created__gte, created__lte, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, enabled, expires, expires__gte, expires__lte, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, key, key__empty, key__ic, key__ie, key__iew, key__iregex, key__isw, key__n, key__nic, key__nie, key__niew, key__nisw, key__regex, last_used, last_used__gte, last_used__lte, pepper_id, pepper_id__empty, pepper_id__gt, pepper_id__gte, pepper_id__lt, pepper_id__lte, pepper_id__n, q, user, user__n, user_id, user_id__n, version, version__ic, version__ie, version__iew, version__iregex, version__isw, version__n, version__nic, version__nie, version__niew, version__nisw, version__regex, write_enabled. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `tokens` (Attributes List) The matching tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the token can authenticate; disabling keeps the token but rejects its use.
- `expires` (String) Expiry as an RFC 3339 timestamp with milliseconds (2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z); never expires when unset.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `key` (String) Identification key NetBox generated for the token; not the secret.
- `last_used` (String) When the token was last used.
- `pepper_id` (Number) Id of the pepper the secret was hashed with.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secret. NetBox returns it in the create response only, so an imported token has none in state and a secret changed outside Terraform goes unnoticed. Changing it replaces the token.
- `url` (String)
- `user_id` (Number) Id of the user the token belongs to.
- `version` (Number) Token format version (1 legacy plaintext, 2 hashed). Defaults to 2. Changing it replaces the token. One of: 1, 2.
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the token permits write operations.
